title: Require Service Public Consumer Sealing
forbids: a literal module-loading edge that visibly enters a standalone service's src/service tree, including a relative sibling-service shortcut from standalone production source
why: Foreign callers cross a standalone service through its deliberate public client face. Literal implementation-tree paths bypass that boundary; the independent private-alias law owns alias edges.
remediate: Import the service's public client face instead of a literal path that enters services/<owner>/src/service. Owner-local proof may use a normalized relative path to its own implementation; foreign and sibling callers use public package exports.
message: Standalone service implementation trees are private to their owning package.
